name: Lore of the Fading Summer
english_description: Fading Summer (v0.2, July 2001), Lontau's MudOS GPLv2 alpha begun from the Lil library shipped with MudOS v22.2b11 as a replacement foundation for Estilore MUD — cleaned Lil commands plus a new login/newuser/verb daemon stack that was never finished into a world.
